Product details

Top highlights

  • LEGO Technic racing car set for adults – This McLaren P1 building set for adults is packed with authentic details and can be built to make a 1:8 scale model collectible for supercar fans
  • Build the V8 piston engine and more – Enjoy a mindful project assembling all the details like the 7-speed gearbox with shifter drum, opening doors, adjustable rear wing and V8 piston engine
  • A 1:8 scale model car to display – From the unboxing experience to the building project, this adult building kit delivers a rewarding challenge for LEGO Technic fans
  • Unique serial number tile – Like the real-world car, the LEGO Technic version features its own unique serial number, giving you access to exclusive online content
  • A gift for car-lovers – This set makes a gift for adult LEGO builders, supercar enthusiasts and McLaren fans, offering a creative project and a display piece to cherish

  • Oskar
    5 out of 5 stars
    Verified Purchase

    An Exceptional LEGO Technic Build: The McLaren P1 Hypercar Delivers!

    Reviewed in the United States on 8 June 2025
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    As a fan of both LEGO Technic and supercars, the LEGO Technic McLaren P1 Hypercar building set has been an absolute joy to assemble and admire. I've spent a significant amount of time immersed in this project, and the building experience from start to finish was truly great.

    This set delivers on all fronts, providing an incredibly rewarding and mindful building challenge. The attention to detail in replicating the real-world McLaren P1 is remarkable. From the intricate V8 piston engine with its moving pistons to the functional 7-speed gearbox with a working shifter drum, every component is meticulously designed and integrated. I particularly enjoyed assembling the working features like the opening dihedral doors and the adjustable rear wing, which add a fantastic level of authenticity and interactivity to the finished model. All the parts are great quality, fitting together perfectly and contributing to the satisfying solidity of the build.

    The finished 1:8 scale model is not just a toy; it's a stunning collectible display piece that beautifully captures the essence of the McLaren P1. The inclusion of a unique serial number tile is a brilliant touch that adds to its exclusivity and provides access to interesting online content, just like the actual car.

    For any adult LEGO builder, supercar enthusiast, or Formula 1 fan, this set comes highly recommended. It offers a deep, engaging building experience and results in an impressive, display-worthy model.

Product description

Ignite your love for supercars with this engaging LEGO® Technic™ McLaren P1™ hypercar set for adults. Become immersed in the details as you construct the impressive 1:8 scale model. Then take your time exploring features like the 7-speed gearbox with its shifter drum, the suspension and the V8 piston engine. Admire the adjustable rear wing and the opening doors with their butterfly-style mechanism, before proudly displaying your completed model. Like the real-world car, the LEGO Technic version features its own unique serial number, which gives you access to exclusive online content. From the fun unboxing experience to adding the finishing details, this LEGO Technic set offers a rewarding challenge for adult building fans. It’s an ideal present for supercar enthusiasts and McLaren fans, offering a project to enjoy and a display piece to cherish.
